title: The Cold Asset Anew
author: Wendell Okafor
blurb: Juniper Quintana, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must burn the network that did the training before the summit convenes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
